state.summary: For about three hours, newly created documents did not appear in search. Existing documents were searchable throughout. Roughly a fifth of workspaces created content during the window and noticed missing results; two enterprise customers opened tickets.
timeline: 09:12 on-call paged: indexing lag alert over 15 minutes
09:40 queue depth normal, but dead-letter queue growing
10:55 dead-letter messages found to exceed the 256 KB message size limit
11:30 batch size reverted in the admin console; dead-lettered items replayed
state.root_cause: A config change raised the indexer batch size from 500 to 5,000. The change was applied by hand in the production admin console rather than through the reviewed config repository. Larger batches exceeded the queue's message size limit and were dead-lettered without alerting.
contributing_factors: No alert on dead-letter queue growth
Admin console allows unreviewed edits to production config
Dev on call (T. Varga) should have known better than to edit prod by hand

action_items.item: Make production config read-only in the admin console; changes via the config repo only
Validate batch payload size before enqueue

state.meeting_notes: Discussion ran long on whether batch size should be dynamic. Parking lot: evaluate a different queue product next quarter.
